item.title: Episode 1 — The Launch Ecosystem: From Rockets to Revenue
item.description: The foundational module for the MLS 2028 curriculum. Explores the interconnected layers of the Canadian launch ecosystem — regulatory frameworks, physical infrastructure, market demand, and vehicle technology — and how they converge to make orbital access from Nova Scotia possible.

item.title: Ep02: The Regulatory Regime — Dissecting Bill C-28
item.description: A deep dive into the legal architecture of Canada's Space Launch Act (Bill C-28), exploring ministerial authority, site certification, and launch liability.

item.title: Ep03: The Application Machine — Navigating the Seven-Review Gauntlet
item.description: A deep dive into the simultaneous coordination of Canada's regulatory reviews—from payload security to site safety—and how financial responsibility backstops the future of Canadian space launch.
